apparent_contradiction: If finished product is 14698.9 kg/day at 10.5% moisture with 15000 kg feed at 10.5% moisture dry solids recovery appears to be 97.993% rather than 98.54%
root_cause_explanation: The previous author evaluated finished product mass at 10.0% moisture (shelf-stable packaging standard in India) not 10.5%. At 10.0% moisture 98.54% recovery yields exactly 14698.88 kg/day. If finished moisture is kept at 10.5% finished mass is 14781.0 kg/day.
reconciled_correct_value: 98.54% recovery at 10.0% target moisture (or 97.99% if 10.5% finished moisture)
mathematical_proof: 15000 kg * (1 - 0.105) = 13425 kg initial dry solids. At 98.54% recovery: finished solids = 13425 * 0.9854 = 13228.995 kg. At 10.0% target moisture: finished product = 13228.995 / 0.90 = 14698.883 kg. EXACT MATCH to 14698.9 kg.

apparent_contradiction: Two conflicting figures reported for daily chemical consumption in a 15 TPD plant with 0.50% NaHCO3 treatment.
root_cause_explanation: 75.0 kg/day was calculated on Dal Feed Mass Basis (0.0050 * 15000 kg). 112.5 kg/day was calculated on Soak Liquor Mass Basis (0.0050 * 22500 kg liquor at 1.5:1 liquor-to-dal ratio).
reconciled_correct_value: 112.5 kg/day for bath formulation at 1.5:1 liquor ratio (75.0 kg/day if liquor ratio is 1.0:1)
mathematical_proof: Liquor mass = 15000 kg * 1.5 = 22500 kg. At 0.50% w/w solution: 22500 * 0.0050 = 112.5 kg active chemical. Dose per tonne dal = 7.50 kg commercial reagent/tonne.

The 8192-node spatial 3D engine allocates 3.65 GB when simulating 81.9 million voxels concurrently. Planning warning applies to unbatched 250000 3D grains (which would require 65.5 GB).
